texture.title: Glint texture
texture.description: Replaces this enchantment glint layer with the resolved texture.

layer.title: Layer
layer.description: Controls this glint layer's render order.

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: Rotates the glint texture and scroll direction in degrees.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Controls how long this glint pauses when global method is cycle.

blend.title: Blend
blend.description: Sets a named or custom OpenGL blend function for the glint texture.

useGlint.title: Use default glint
useGlint.description: Controls whether the default enchantment glint is shown on the item.
